overview:
McLeodganj and Bir in one weekend: this **2 Nights / 3 Days** group trip leaves Delhi in the evening, with pickup from Chandigarh also available. The departure time and location are shared once your booking is confirmed. You get a short briefing from the trip leaders and travel overnight in an AC vehicle.

Day 1 is McLeodganj: the flea market, Bhagsu waterfall, Dalai Lama Monastery and cafes, with dinner and a night at the hotel. Day 2 is the drive to Bir with stops at Dharamshala HPCA Stadium, Palampur tea gardens and Baijnath Temple, ending with a bonfire and light music. On Day 3 you head to the Billing take-off site for paragliding (cost extra) before the evening departure. Prices start at ₹7,699 per person on quad sharing (5% GST extra).

faqs.q: Where and when does the trip start?
faqs.a: Departure is in the evening from Delhi. The exact pickup point and time are shared once your booking is confirmed. Pickup from Chandigarh is also available. You travel overnight and reach the hills the next morning.

faqs.q: How much does the McLeodganj & Bir Billing trip cost?
faqs.a: ₹7,699 per person on quad sharing, ₹8,199 on triple sharing and ₹8,699 on double sharing. 5% GST is extra.

1 night in a hotel at McLeodganj and 1 night in camps at Bir, 2 breakfasts and 2 dinners, transfers in an AC vehicle, sightseeing as per the itinerary and a tour curator. Dinner on the journey from Delhi is not included.

faqs.q: Is paragliding included in the price?
faqs.a: No. On Day 3 you go to the Billing paragliding take-off site, but the paragliding cost is extra and paid separately.
The first night is in a hotel at McLeodganj and the second night is in camps at Bir. Extra mattresses are provided for triple and quad sharing.

faqs.q: How do I book and pay?
faqs.a: Reserve your seat by paying 50% of the trip cost, and pay the rest at least 4 days before the trip. 5% GST is added to the price.

Cancel more than 10 days before the travel date and 50% of the advance is refunded; 5 to 10 days before, 25% of the advance; less than 5 days before, there is no refund. There is no refund for no-shows or early check-outs.

faqs.q: What do I need to carry?
faqs.a: A valid government-approved photo ID is a must: there is no boarding without it. Also pack comfortable clothes, sports or trekking shoes, a warm layer for the season, personal medicines and some cash. The full list is under Things To Pack.
